reader.edition-search: CallProgram's freshInstance/CancelContained/EndInitialActivation read no edition (grep Edition, DialectBehavior, IsAvailable in ProgramTable.cs).
reader.requirement: At 85 a called program with the initial attribute, and every program it contains, is placed in its initial state on every call; a contained non-initial program keeps its state across calls within one activation of the initial program and is initial again at that program's next call; EXTERNAL data is not program-internal and persists.

edition-consulted.switches: asks CancelNode with refusesEveryActiveProgram: true at every edition (no contained program is active at an initial program's entry or exit, so the two editions agree)
RECURSIVE (and so the INITIAL/RECURSIVE combination checks) refused at 85; INITIAL is accepted at every edition

reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_03 covers a counter in an initial program and its contained program across two calls; not covered: ALTER state, ODO data, a contained program called twice in one activation, EXTERNAL and GLOBAL data, an explicit CANCEL of an initial program

probes.printed: ONE -1.5 1 A / NC 1 / NC 2 / ONE -1.5 1 A / NC 1 / NC 2 / TWO -0.5 2 AB / NC 3 / NC 4 / ONE -1.5 1 A / NC 1 / NC 2 / TWO -0.5 2 AB / NC 3 / NC 4 (run gr6a-002, MATCH)
probes.expected: each call starts unaltered with VALUE data and ODO count; within one activation the ALTER and NC's counter persist; the next call resets both (§1985:X.2.4.2 GR4)

reader.notes: g85_f02_03 MATCHes at 85. An initial program gets a fresh instance per activation and CancelContained resets its contained programs at entry; EndInitialActivation is the implicit CANCEL at exit (files closed, contained programs canceled).

refuter.evidence: g67: INITIAL IP calls its contained non-initial NF twice per activation; NF opens a sequential file at first entry: NF OPEN 00 / R001 / R002 on each IP call (NF and its file are initial again at each call of IP, kept within an activation). g8: INITIAL INI's contained INI2 reads an EXTERNAL indexed file positioned by the caller; INI's implicit cancel leaves the external file positioned. cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.2.4 GR6 the text is in GR6; OK §1985:X.2.4.2 the text is in the clause; it lies in GR4.
